# hostereo_images (Data Source)

Active OS images. Each image belongs to one region. Public; no API key needed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hostereo_images" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `region_id` (String) Only images of this region (UUID from `hostereo_regions`).

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `version` (String)
